title: Samplet limits and multiwavelets
summary: Samplets are data adapted multiresolution analyses of localized discrete signed measures. They can be constructed on scattered data sites in arbitrary dimension such that they exhibit vanishing moments with respect to any prescribed set of primitives. We consider the samplet construction in a probabilistic framework and show that, if choosing polynomials as primitives, the resulting samplet basis converges to signed measures with broken polynomial densities in the infinite data limit.
